rawText:
<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User wants a modern island with an integrated sink.
* 🔴 (10:00) User stated the general contractor initially quoted $18,400 for the remodel.
* 🔴 (10:00) User approved a $515 36-inch undermount stainless sink (with quiet disposal) and a matte black faucet with a pull-out spray head and matching soap dispenser.
* 🔴 (20:20) User set a deadline to finalize all fixture selections by May 10, 2026.
* 🟡 (20:20) Agent scheduled a virtual demo for the sink and contacted GreenPipe Co. for plumbing subcontractor availability next week.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User prefers a brushed nickel finish for cabinet hardware.
* 🔴 (15:20) User approved a $4,200 2-cm quartz waterfall countertop (delivery May 15) and requested a matching backsplash tile.
* 🔴 (16:30) User stated the revised contractor quote is $21,250.
* 🔴 (17:00) User set a deadline to finalize backsplash selection by May 12, 2026.
* 🟡 (17:00) Agent identified a $1,150 herringbone subway tile for the backsplash and highlighted a $275 dimmable RGB LED under-cabinet lighting kit.

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User expressed interest in adding a pull-out pantry drawer to the lower cabinets.
* 🔴 (10:45) User asked about installing a pot-filler faucet beside the new stainless-steel sink.
* 🔴 (15:15) User set a firm deadline to finalize all appliance selections by May 18, 2026.
* 🟡 (15:15) Agent sourced a $420 pull-out pot-filler (model PF-250), a $1,120 compact under-counter fridge (ChillBox CB-300), and recommended a $85 self-watering herb kit.
* 🟡 (15:15) Agent highlighted "Arctic Fog" paint ($45/gallon) for its low VOC rating and scheduled a virtual color-consultation.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User confirmed they want a "Calacatta Gold" finish for the island quartz countertop.
* 🔴 (10:35) User asked whether a brushed nickel finish would complement existing stainless-steel appliances.
* 🔴 (13:05) User set a milestone to approve all lighting selections by May 16, 2026.
* 🔴 (14:10) User set a rule: always send photos before any wall is opened up.
* 🔴 (15:00) User would like a small wine fridge on the right side of the pantry for entertaining guests.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent received a $4,750 quote for a 12-ft Calacatta Gold quartz slab (including delivery) and scheduled a site visit for May 15.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent identified $12 brushed nickel cabinet handles matching the sink's style and compiled LED under-cabinet lighting options, highlighting a dimmable 3000K strip at $68 per fixture.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent sourced a $920 compact wine cooler (VinoVault VC-210) and added it to the appliance list.

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User confirmed selection of matte white cabinets from Oakridge Cabinets, model 'LunaSeries' ($1,850 each, delivery by June 5).
* 🔴 (08:55) User asked whether a glass subway tile backsplash in 'Arctic Pearl' would match the new cabinets.
* 🔴 (11:50) User requested a permit for new plumbing fixtures to be submitted by May 22.
* 🔴 (13:00) User will be out of town from May 24-26 and asked to pause noisy demolition work during that period.
* 🟡 (14:45) Agent identified 'Arctic Pearl' glass tiles ($42/pack), added a built-in coffee station to the layout, scheduled an electrical inspection for May 20, and submitted the plumbing permit application (PR-2026-517).
* 🟡 (14:45) Agent adjusted the demolition schedule, moving wall removal to May 27.
* ✅ (14:45) Agent uploaded a revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and new faucet for user review.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User confirmed selection of a "RiverEdge" light gray quartz countertop from StoneCraft ($3,200 per slab).
* 🔴 (08:50) User asked whether brushed nickel pendant lights would complement the new cabinets and countertop.
* 🔴 (09:55) User prefers the kitchen island to include a built-in 12-bottle wine cooler.
* 🔴 (11:40) User requested a smart thermostat integration with the existing HVAC system, specifying brand "EcoTemp".
* 🔴 (18:00) User stated the appliance allowance is $6,300.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent ordered three RiverEdge countertop slabs (delivery June 8), identified three "Nimbus" brushed nickel pendants ($89 each, 3-week lead time), added a ChillBox C12 wine cooler to the island layout, and ordered an EcoTemp Pro thermostat (installation June 15).
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent booked a plumbing rough-in inspection for May 28 and programmed the Nimbus pendants with a Zig-Bee dimmer module.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent uploaded a revised floor plan showing the countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme for user review.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent sent a summary email with next milestones: countertop delivery June 8, lighting installation June 13, thermostat setup June 15.
</observations>
<current-task>
Primary: Finalize appliance selections (deadline May 18, 2026 - passed, but still pending user confirmation/review of current selections).
Secondary: User review of revised 3-D kitchen model (cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, faucet) and revised floor plan (countertop, island wine cooler, lighting scheme).
Secondary: Plumbing rough-in inspection (May 28).
Secondary: Demolition work (starting May 27).
Secondary: Countertop delivery (June 8).
Secondary: Lighting installation (June 13).
Secondary: Thermostat setup (June 15).
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to respond to the uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model and floor plan, and to confirm appliance selections, especially given the passed deadline for appliance finalization and the stated appliance allowance.
</suggested-response>
